parameters.query:
SELECT
  id,
  ip_address,
  incident_id,
  detection_type,
  severity,
  deployment_type,
  blocked_at,
  expires_at,
  unblock_attempts
FROM blocked_ips
WHERE
  is_active    = true
  AND expires_at <= NOW()
  AND unblock_attempts < 3
ORDER BY expires_at ASC
LIMIT 100;

parameters.query:
UPDATE blocked_ips
SET
  is_active         = false,
  unblocked_at      = NOW(),
  unblock_reason    = 'TTL_EXPIRED',
  updated_at        = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.db_record_id }}
RETURNING ip_address, incident_id, unblocked_at;

INSERT INTO unblock_audit_log (
  ip_address, incident_id, detection_type, severity,
  blocked_at, expires_at, unblocked_at,
  unblock_status, unblock_reason, deployment_type
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.ip_address }}',
  '{{ $json.incident_id }}',
  '{{ $json.detection_type }}',
  '{{ $json.severity }}',
  '{{ $json.blocked_at }}',
  '{{ $json.expires_at }}',
  NOW(),
  '{{ $json.unblock_status }}',
  'TTL_EXPIRED',
  '{{ $json.deployment_type }}'
);

UPDATE blocked_ips
SET
  unblock_attempts  = {{ $json.unblock_attempts }},
  last_unblock_error = $body${{ $json.error_detail || '' }}$body$,
  updated_at        = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.db_record_id }};

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_active = true AND expires_at > NOW())  AS currently_blocked,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_active = false AND unblocked_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') AS unblocked_last_24h,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_active = true AND unblock_attempts >= 3) AS stuck_blocks,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_active = true AND expires_at <= NOW() AND unblock_attempts >= 3) AS max_retries_exceeded
FROM blocked_ips;

SELECT
  id, ip_address, incident_id, detection_type, severity,
  deployment_type, blocked_at, expires_at, unblock_attempts
FROM blocked_ips
WHERE
  is_active        = true
  AND expires_at   <= NOW()
  AND unblock_attempts >= 3
ORDER BY expires_at ASC
LIMIT 50;
